brief:
Israeli forces demolished five Palestinian residential buildings in the occupied West Bank on Thursday without warning, displacing more than 100 people, Middle East Eye reported. The demolitions occurred without advance notice to residents.

The incident marks the latest in a series of building demolitions in the territory. Palestinians have faced repeated displacement as Israeli authorities continue enforcement actions against structures deemed to lack proper permits.

title: Israeli forces demolish five West Bank buildings, displace 100 Palestinians
